title: tectaria melanocaulos

This plant is known for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory conditions, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
